content:
**Relay Tower DP-B5-21** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia. It can be found directly north of Uncanny Caverns.

This is a standard radio relay tower with a view of Summersville Lake far to the north. The building is surrounded by a combination of wire fence and wall and there is an old Jeep parked on the road outside. Laser Turrets guard the building entrances to the southeast and southwest.

Inside the building is a gray system relay terminal which US government supply requisition holotapes can be loaded into. There are fold-down cots and lockers along the northeast wall and both an Ammo Box and First Aid beside the lockers. Various chems may also be found scattered around the building.

The relay tower terminal can be used with a US government supply requisition holotape for the quest Request Government Air Drop.

Potential mod box - Under one of the cots along the northeast wall.

Relay Tower DP-B5-21 appears in *Fallout 76*.
